author: lov.31
title: Over it.
content:
I get so frustrated every time I use this app. The picture resizing is ridiculous. I should be able to just type in the size I want rather than having to manually resize it myself. The amount of time I have spent dancing between 5.01 and 4.99 to get it to 5.00 is insane. Then trying to use paper that is already the size I want doesn’t work either because it does not allow me to print without boarders. Like you really think I want borders on my picture when the paper is 4x6? No I really don’t. 

Also not necessarily the app but the ink subscription is also ridiculous. I get it says that it “charges per page” but I don’t care you’re ripping people off. It has charged me over $30 a month for the past three months and I have had the same ink cartridges since I put the insta ink ones in. I have canceled my subscription but now I will still have to pay for one more month because it is still gonna charge me for whatever I use this month and even if these cartridges are bigger than store bought I have still definitely payed for them already. 

I regret buying an Hp printer and it won’t be happening again and I would never recommend someone else buy one. I may try to sell or honestly trash this one and buy from a different company. I’m sure no one at the company will care about my opinion because they are going to unfortunately continue to make money anyways but if I can at least deter one person from dealing with the frustration I have dealt with, me writing this and possibly many more will be worth it.
